local_facts.title: Older housing and desert ground
local_facts.claim: University of Arizona’s housing analysis says Tucson’s largest share of homes was built in 1970–1979. Its Cooperative Extension guide describes caliche as a desert-soil layer cemented by calcium carbonate that may form at or below the surface.
local_facts.why_it_matters: A water path in an established home can be far from the visible wet area, and below-grade access has to be planned around the actual slab, pipe route and ground rather than assumed from the symptom.

local_facts.title: Tucson repair permit threshold
local_facts.claim: The City of Tucson says an accessible leak repair or clog clearing can be exempt, while repairs that replace or reroute pipes, valves or fixtures—especially inside walls, under floors or behind access panels—require a permit.
local_facts.why_it_matters: A visit can stop an emergency, but an under-floor or in-wall pipe replacement may need a documented next step instead of being treated as a simple accessible repair.

local_facts.title: A documented flooding history
local_facts.claim: Pima County records six presidential-declared flood disasters in the Tucson area between July 1977 and July 1993: October 1977, March 1978, December 1978, October 1983, July 1990 and January 1993.
local_facts.why_it_matters: During heavy water events, exterior access and a property’s drainage path can affect safe arrival, assessment and the order in which an emergency plumbing problem is contained.

pricing.table_head: Posted Tucson prices, job by job

anchors.label: Residential trade permit, water heater or sewer repair
anchors.detail: One flat trade permit covers a like-for-like water heater, a sewer or building drain repair, or a water service line, including two inspections.
anchors.source_name: City of Tucson adopted development services fee schedule

anchors.label: Each additional permitted item on the same trade permit
anchors.detail: Two or more items on one plumbing permit cost $118.51 for the first plus $20.70 for each one after it.
anchors.source_name: City of Tucson adopted development services fee schedule

anchors.label: New water service line and 5/8 inch meter, Tucson Water
anchors.detail: Tucson Water charges $2,700 for a new service line and meter where pavement is replaced, $1,740 where it is not, and $450 to $560 to set a meter on an existing service.

anchors.label: Median hourly wage, plumbers, pipefitters and steamfitters
anchors.detail: May 2025 median for the 1,170 people in the trade across the Tucson metro area, a little over half the San Jose figure.
anchors.source_name: BLS Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics, May 2025
